research_papers.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
research_papers.authors: Yuntao Bai, Saurav Kadavath, et al. (Anthropic)
research_papers.abstract: We describe a method for training a harmless AI assistant through self-improvement without human labels. The process involves a supervised learning phase where the model critiques its own responses based on a set of principles (a constitution), followed by reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF).

research_papers.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
research_papers.abstract: Transformers struggle with long sequences due to quadratic complexity. We propose Mamba, a new architecture based on selective state-space models (SSMs) that achieves linear scaling in sequence length while matching Transformer performance on language modeling tasks.

research_papers.title: AlphaFold 3: Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions
research_papers.authors: John Jumper, Demis Hassabis, et al. (Google DeepMind)
research_papers.abstract: We introduce AlphaFold 3, a model that can predict the structure of complexes including proteins, nucleic acids, small molecules, ions, and modified residues. This unified framework significantly improves accuracy across all interaction types.

research_papers.title: Generative Models for De Novo Protein Design
research_papers.abstract: Recent advances in diffusion models allow for the generation of protein backbones with no known homology in nature. This paper explores the application of these models to therapeutic design, specifically for binding to viral epitopes.
